Letter of May 8, 1972, to the Texas Executive Department, Division of Planning Coordination from Parks and Wildlife Department.
<u>Comment</u>: Indicates their is no justification for the action to place full responsibility for rare and endangered species management in the hands of the Federal Government.
Response: See Nevada Fish and Game Department reply.
Comment: Questions third paragraph of section headed "Alternatives" when it refers to "...selective imposition of the sanctions authorized by this bill..."

The sanctions they note which might be imposed are not listed but usually involve withholding of Federal support for one or more programs.
Response: See comments noted in reply to the States of Indiana and Nebraska.
